thread:
elaine: Quick kickoff for Nimbus Labs hardware preview (NDA completed). We have rack access next week and they want a small public-facing marketplace listing after a successful pilot. Need owners for benchmarks, infra access, telemetry, and marketing assets. Can people volunteer? Link to onboarding doc: https://drive.redwood/example-nimbus-onboard :nerd_face:

sam: I can own benchmarks. Plan is a 3x3 matrix: batch sizes [1,8,32] x quant profiles [fp16,int8/q4] across sequence lengths [512,2048]. Need the prompt set + expected eval metrics from product. I'll also run stress tests for KV-cache behavior.

ryan: Infra note: provisioned a dedicated EAP pool (tag: nimbus-eap). Jumpbox + basic container registry image pushed. I need SSH pubkeys and the partner's allowed IP ranges. I can start node bring-up tomorrow.

katie: Marketplace & comms: I'll draft the listing (short blurb, bullets, compliance checklist). We should avoid publishing until performance & privacy checks pass. Timeline ask: assets (logo, short desc, contact) by next Tue so we can queue the marketplace review.

ben: I'll assemble the prompt set and the evaluation rubric. Proposed scorecard fields: p95 latency (ms), median tokens/sec, peak GPU memory (GB), 99th failure rate, and quality regressions vs baseline. Baseline model: redwood/redwood-13b-quant (we can swap per partner).

lab-bot: bench-runner started: run-id=nimbus-2765432111-smoke. Logs streaming to /s3/redwood-eap/nimbus/2765432111/logs.

elaine: Owners so far: @sam benchmarks, @ryan infra, @katie marketplace, @ben prompts. I'll request Nimbus's logo and IP list. Also confirm NDA clause about embargoed results — legal ok with partner seeing raw telemetry before public.

sam: Starting smoke run now — will post summary once complete. Smoke command we use for reproducibility:

```
python run_bench.py --model redwood/redwood-13b-quant \ 
  --prompts s3://redwood-evals/nimbus/smoke_prompts.jsonl \ 
  --batch 8 --seq_len 512 --quant q4 \ 
  --out s3://redwood-eap/nimbus/2765432111/results.csv
```

sam: quick smoke output snapshot:
```
[INFO] 2026-03-26 09:12:01 - avg_latency_ms: 42.7
[INFO] 2026-03-26 09:12:01 - tokens_per_sec: 620
[WARN] 2026-03-26 09:12:05 - some kv-miss spikes under synthetic workload (investigating)
```

ryan: Jumpbox credentials delivered via 1Password item: nimbus-eap-jumpbox. Also opened firewall rule to their CIDR 198.51.100.0/24 per their security contact.

katie: :eyes: I'll draft marketplace copy and attach a checklist for legal to confirm NDA-embargo language. Elaine — can you ask Nimbus for a 300px SVG logo and a 1-paragraph partner quote?

ben: Uploaded prompt set and expected output checks to the onboarding doc (link above). Suggest we gate public announcement until: (1) benchmarks pass stability (7-day run) and (2) partner sign-off on the writeup.

elaine: Sounds good. Can we get an initial run-by date? Prefer EOD Fri for a first smoke summary then a deeper 7-day run next week. I'll schedule a 30m sync Thu 11am PT to align. Please ping if blocked. :party_parrot:

sam: :thumbsup: Running extended tests overnight, will post aggregated CSV and a short PR with run-notes tomorrow morning.

lab-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-eap/nimbus/2765432111/bench-results-summary.csv

ryan: If anyone needs additional network setup or persistent volumes, DM me.

katie: Noted. I'll put a draft marketplace listing into the marketing drive and tag you all for review.

elaine: Thanks team — will follow up after Thu sync with a checklist and announcement cadence. If Nimbus requests a joint blog we will coordinate dates post-stability.
